title: Massive fire at Bangkok pub kills at least 27 people
facts: A fire at the Rong Beer Na Lat Phrao bar and restaurant in Bangkok killed at least 27 people.
The Bangkok pub fire resulted in 63 people being hospitalized with injuries.
Twenty-two injured victims from the Bangkok venue fire were reported in critical condition.
Bangkok Governor Chadchart Sittipunt stated that smoke inhalation was the probable primary cause of death.
Investigators reported that multiple victims were discovered near a potentially obstructed fire exit.
Eyewitness Kan Kutirat observed smoke originating near the stage at approximately 10:00 pm on Sunday.
Thai national police confirmed that firefighters brought the blaze under control around 2:00 am Monday.
Thai Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul visited the site of the bar fire to assess the situation.
Musicians reported hearing an explosion after power failed following smoke from a circuit breaker near the stage.
Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul stated that many panicked patrons fled toward rear toilets that had no emergency exit.
A fire at the Mountain B nightclub in Thailand's Chonburi province killed 25 people in 2022.
A fire during a 2009 New Year's Eve celebration at Bangkok's Santika club killed 67 people.
Over 200 people were injured in the 2009 Santika club fire in Bangkok.
The Rong Beer Na Lat Phrao venue is located on the outskirts of the Thai capital.
Most exterior windows of the bar were blown out during the course of the fire.
